propositions: Four capability call sites use static cast but lack runtime isinstance guards before invoking optional members (add_comment, set_relationship) on TicketTransport, making the calls succeed without validation.

A transport missing an opt-in capability raises AttributeError inside a broad except Exception block, silently skipping the mutation and reporting success instead of distinguishing absence from failure.

Runtime guards must use isinstance against @runtime_checkable Protocols rather than hasattr to maintain type safety and consistency with ADR-0083, with fallback member checks for proxy/wrapper transports.

Designed capability absence must be observable via existing bridge_alerts channel with distinct kinds (outbound-comment-capability-absent, outbound-link-capability-absent) and INFO logging, never silently swallowed.
Module size constraint on dispatch_one.py (800 LOC cap) requires relocating _call_with_retry (~75 lines) to dispatch_apply_phases.py to make room for guards without exceeding the absolute gate.
Capability present but raising must remain on the pre-existing failure path (warning/stderr, comment_errors capture) and NOT produce a capability-absent alert kind.
